  | `GET`  | `/signature`                                            | Signed manifest for the current version                                                                                                                                                             |
</div>

<div className="lm-diff-ins lm-diff-block">
  Versions [#versions]
</div>

<div className="lm-diff-ins lm-diff-block">
  | Method | Path (after `/groups/:groupID/distribution-sets/:name`)   | Description                                           |
  | ------ | --------------------------------------------------------- | ----------------------------------------------------- |
  | `GET`  | `/versions`                                               | Stored version snapshots                              |
  | `GET`  | `/versions/:version`                                      | One snapshot, with manifest metadata                  |
  | `GET`  | `/versions/:version/signature`                            | Signed manifest, signature and certificate            |
  | `GET`  | `/versions/:version/modules`                              | Modules of that version                               |
  | `GET`  | `/versions/:version/modules/:moduleKey/artifact/download` | A module's deliverable at that version. Native: `501` |
  | `GET`  | `/versions/:version/artifacts-archive`                    | `.tar.gz` of that version's artifacts                 |
</div>

<div className="lm-diff-ins lm-diff-block">
  Request bodies [#request-bodies]
</div>

<div className="lm-diff-ins lm-diff-block">
  | Route                         | Body                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                 |
  | ----------------------------- | ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
  | Create pack                   | Required: `name`, `version` (semver `x.y.z`), `group_id`. Optional: `type` (`rawfile` or `firmware`), `packaging` (`swu`, the default, or `non-swu`), `allow_previous_version_download`, `modules`, `preconditions`. Each `modules` entry is a new module (`type`, `name`, optional `version` and `delivery_intent`) or an existing one (`source_module_id`). hawkBit mode accepts only `source_module_id` entries, of **built** modules             |
  | `POST .../new`                | `{"version":"x.y.z"}`: semver, and greater than the current version, or `400`                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        |
  | `PUT .../preconditions`       | `{"preconditions":[{"required_distribution_set_name":"...","min_version":"1.2.0"}]}`. Use `required_module_key` (`type:name`) instead of the pack name to target a module. Exactly one of the two per entry, and `min_version` must be `x.y.z`. A device must satisfy every entry                                                                                                                                                                    |
  | `POST .../swu`, `.../package` | `user`, `encryption_key_name`, `encryption_alg_name`, `sw_desc_encrypted`, `signature_key_id`, `signature_alg_name`, `signature_certificate` (PEM), `selected_artifact_ids`. All optional, but `user` is required with `encryption_key_name`. A body with `encryption_alg_name` only requests per-device encryption. An empty or invalid body builds without encryption. See [Signing and encryption](/docs/platform/updates/signing-and-encryption) |
</div>

<div className="lm-diff-ins lm-diff-block">
  Artifacts reach a build only through `selected_artifact_ids`; without them there is normally nothing staged and the build fails. A build replaces the pack's carried artifact links with the selected ones.
</div>

<div className="lm-diff-ins lm-diff-block">
  Responses [#responses]
</div>

<div className="lm-diff-ins lm-diff-block">
  * Create routes answer `201` with the object: a pack, a module, or for a launch the launch ID and the precondition outcome. `modules` is an input of pack creation and is not returned on reads.
  * `DELETE` of a pack answers `200` with `{"message": "..."}`. `POST .../new`, `.../swu` and `.../package` answer `200` with `{"message": "..."}`.
  * Artifact uploads answer `{"msg": "...", "artifact": {...}}`: `201` for `POST /artifacts`, `200` for the pack-scoped and module-scoped uploads.
  * Descriptor uploads on a pack or on a module in a pack answer `{"msg": "..."}`.
  * Module lists answer `{"modules": [...]}`. The pack-scoped `.../artifacts` list answers a bare array.
  * A failed build leaves the pack in status `build_failed`, with the reason in `last_build_error`. It is editable and can be built again.
</div>

<div className="lm-diff-ins lm-diff-block">
  Objects [#objects]
</div>

<div className="lm-diff-ins lm-diff-block">
  The field definitions are in `pkg/models/updates.go` in the [repository](https://github.com/lamassuiot/ota). These are the fields clients read most.
</div>

<div className="lm-diff-ins lm-diff-block">
  Pack [#pack]
</div>

<div className="lm-diff-ins lm-diff-block">
  | Field                                                                              | Meaning                                                                              |
  | ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ |
  | `id`, `name`, `version`, `group_id`                                                | Identity. The version is semver                                                      |
  | `type`                                                                             | `rawfile` or `firmware`                                                              |
  | `packaging`                                                                        | `swu` or `non-swu`                                                                   |
  | `status`                                                                           | `draft`, `built` or `build_failed`                                                   |
  | `uri`                                                                              | Download URI of the built deliverable. Empty until built                             |
  | `sw-descriptor`                                                                    | The sw-description text (the key has a hyphen)                                       |
  | `encryption_mode`                                                                  | Empty, `shared` or `per-device`                                                      |
  | `encryption_key_name`, `encryption_alg_name`, `encryption_iv`, `sw_desc_encrypted` | Encryption settings of the last build                                                |
  | `signature_key_id`, `signature_alg_name`, `signature_certificate`                  | Signing settings of the last build                                                   |
  | `built_device_count`, `total_device_count`, `uncovered_devices`                    | Per-device builds only: coverage, and the devices without a package with a `reason`  |
  | `allow_previous_version_download`                                                  | Whether older versions can be downloaded                                             |
  | `preconditions`                                                                    | The pack's launch preconditions                                                      |
  | `last_build_error`                                                                 | Why the last build failed                                                            |
  | `locked`                                                                           | hawkBit mode: the backend froze the composition because the pack was sent to devices |
  | `created_at`, `updated_at`                                                         | Timestamps                                                                           |
</div>

<div className="lm-diff-ins lm-diff-block">
  Launch [#launch]
</div>

<div className="lm-diff-ins lm-diff-block">
  A launch carries `id`, `group_id`, `name`, `description`, `version`, `exec_date`, `scheduled_at`, `status`, the strategy fields (`workflow_type`, `rollout_type`, `rollout_value`, `test_device_id`, `auto`, `approval_threshold`, `error_threshold`, `weight`), `distribution_set_id`, `distribution_set_name`, the counters `pending_count`, `active_count`, `completed_count`, `failed_count`, `total_devices`, `completed_in_batch`, `test_device_status`, `aborted`, `forced_preconditions` and `precondition_failures`.
</div>

<div className="lm-diff-ins lm-diff-block">
  `status` is `running` (empty on a native launch that has not changed state yet, which also means running), `paused`, `cancelled` or `completed`. `test_device_status` is `pending`, `active`, `completed`, `failed` or `cancelled`.
</div>

<div className="lm-diff-ins lm-diff-block">
  Software module [#software-module]
</div>

<div className="lm-diff-ins lm-diff-block">
  | Field                                                                                                                                       | Meaning                                                                                      |
  | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- | -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
  | `id`, `key`                                                                                                                                 | Catalog ID and `type:name` key                                                               |
  | `type`, `name`, `version`                                                                                                                   | `type` is `os` or `application`                                                              |
  | `delivery_intent`                                                                                                                           | `undecided`, `swu-build`, `swu-prebuilt` or `raw`                                            |
  | `built`, `locked`                                                                                                                           | Whether its deliverable exists, and whether it is frozen because a version of it has shipped |
  | `artifacts`                                                                                                                                 | The module's files                                                                           |
  | `encrypted`, `encryption_mode`, `encryption_key_name`, `encryption_alg_name`, `sw_desc_encrypted`, `signature_key_id`, `signature_alg_name` | How it was built                                                                             |
  | `release_notes`                                                                                                                             | The operator changelog                                                                       |
  | `uri`, `created_at`, `updated_at`                                                                                                           | Download URI, timestamps                                                                     |
</div>

<div className="lm-diff-ins lm-diff-block">
  Artifact [#artifact]
</div>

<div className="lm-diff-ins lm-diff-block">
  `id`, `name`, `version`, `filename`, `checksum` (SHA-256 of the file), `size` in bytes and `uploaded_at`. The fleet-wide list adds `distribution_sets`: the packs that reference it, each with `distribution_set_id`, `distribution_set_name`, `distribution_set_version` and `group_id`. A file whose name ends in `.swu` or `.tar.gz` must look like one, or the upload answers `400`.
</div>

<div className="lm-diff-ins lm-diff-block">
  Modules inside a pack [#modules-inside-a-pack]
</div>

<div className="lm-diff-ins lm-diff-block">
  | Method   | Path (after `/groups/:groupID/distribution-sets/:name`) | Description                                                                                                                                      |
  | -------- | ------------------------------------------------------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ |
  | `GET`    | `/modules`                                              | List the pack's modules                                                                                                                          |
  | `POST`   | `/modules`                                              | Add a module (body: `type`, `name`, optional `version`, `delivery_intent`). Answers `201`. hawkBit mode: `400`, create the module in the catalog |
  | `GET`    | `/modules/reusable`                                     | Modules on other packs, offered for import. Each reports `shared` and its source pack                                                            |
  | `POST`   | `/modules/import`                                       | Compose from an existing module. Answers `201`                                                                                                   |
  | `PUT`    | `/modules/:moduleKey`                                   | Swap the module for another version of itself (body `{"source_module_id":"<catalog id>"}`). Native: `501`                                        |
  | `DELETE` | `/modules/:moduleKey`                                   | Remove a module from the pack                                                                                                                    |
  | `PUT`    | `/modules/:moduleKey/release-notes`                     | Set the operator changelog (body `{"notes":"..."}`, empty clears it). Allowed on built versions                                                  |
  | `POST`   | `/modules/:moduleKey/artifact/upload`                   | Upload a binary onto a module (fields `file`, `artifact_name`, `version`). hawkBit mode: refused, a linked module is frozen                      |
  | `POST`   | `/modules/:moduleKey/artifact/link`                     | Link a global artifact to the module (body `{"artifact_id":"..."}`). hawkBit mode: refused                                                       |
  | `POST`   | `/modules/:moduleKey/descriptor/upload`                 | A module's own sw-description. Native: `501`. hawkBit mode: `400`, use `POST /softwaremodules/by-id/:moduleID/descriptor`                        |
  | `POST`   | `/modules/:moduleKey/build`                             | Pack-scoped module build. Always refused: `501` in native mode and `400` in hawkBit mode. Use `POST /softwaremodules/by-id/:moduleID/build`      |
  | `GET`    | `/modules/:moduleKey/artifact/download`                 | Download a module's deliverable. Native: `501`                                                                                                   |
</div>

<div className="lm-diff-ins lm-diff-block">
  Import body: `source_module_id`, or `source_distribution_set_name` and `module_key` (with optional `source_group_id` and `source_distribution_set_version`). A module's delivery intent must be decided and compatible with the pack's packaging before it can be imported.
</div>

<div className="lm-diff-ins lm-diff-block">
  Software module catalog [#software-module-catalog]
</div>

<div className="lm-diff-ins lm-diff-block">
  Modules that exist independently of any pack. Create one with `POST /softwaremodules`, giving `type`, `name`, `version` and optionally `delivery_intent` (default `undecided`). Use the returned `id` for the `by-id` routes.
</div>

<div className="lm-diff-ins lm-diff-block">
  | Method   | Path                                                              | Description                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                               |
  | -------- | ----------------------------------------------------------------- | ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
  | `GET`    | `/softwaremodules`                                                | Fleet-wide catalog, with the source pack                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  |
  | `POST`   | `/softwaremodules`                                                | Declare a module with no pack yet. Answers `201`. `type`, `name` and `version` are required                                                                                                                                                                                               |
  | `DELETE` | `/softwaremodules/:moduleKey/versions/:version`                   | Delete a module that no pack holds. `400` if a pack still holds it                                                                                                                                                                                                                        |
  | `GET`    | `/softwaremodules/by-id/:moduleID`                                | Read one module                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                           |
  | `PUT`    | `/softwaremodules/by-id/:moduleID`                                | Update `delivery_intent` and `release_notes`. Send at least one                                                                                                                                                                                                                           |
  | `POST`   | `/softwaremodules/by-id/:moduleID/artifacts`                      | Upload a file (field `file`). Answers `201` with the artifact                                                                                                                                                                                                                             |
  | `GET`    | `/softwaremodules/by-id/:moduleID/artifacts/:artifactID/download` | Download a stored file                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    |
  | `DELETE` | `/softwaremodules/by-id/:moduleID/artifacts/:artifactID`          | Remove a file. Answers `204`                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              |
  | `POST`   | `/softwaremodules/by-id/:moduleID/descriptor`                     | Upload the sw-description the build reads (field `file`). Answers the module                                                                                                                                                                                                              |
  | `POST`   | `/softwaremodules/by-id/:moduleID/build`                          | Build this module's deliverable. hawkBit mode only (`501` in native). Behaviour depends on `delivery_intent`. The body is optional and takes `user`, `encryption_key_name`, `encryption_alg_name`, `sw_desc_encrypted`, `signature_key_id`, `signature_alg_name`, `signature_certificate` |
</div>

<div className="lm-diff-ins lm-diff-block">
  Files are accepted while the delivery is `undecided`. A `swu-build` module takes build inputs and refuses a `.swu`; a `swu-prebuilt` module takes exactly one `.swu`. Choose a compatible delivery intent before importing the module with `source_module_id`. Once a module has shipped (a released pack version holds it, or hawkBit locked it) it is locked: its content is protected, while release notes stay editable. In native mode the pack builds one `.swu` from every module's inputs, and a prebuilt SWU is uploaded to the whole pack rather than imported as a module input.
</div>

<div className="lm-diff-ins lm-diff-block">
  Request bodies [#request-bodies-1]
</div>

<div className="lm-diff-ins lm-diff-block">
  | Route                                       | Body                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                       |
  | ------------------------------------------- | ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
  | `POST .../modules`, `POST /softwaremodules` | `type` (`os` or `application`), `name` (no `/` or `:`), `version`, `delivery_intent`                                                                                                                                                                                                                       |
  | `POST .../modules/import`                   | `source_module_id`, or `source_distribution_set_name` and `module_key`                                                                                                                                                                                                                                     |
  | `PUT /softwaremodules/by-id/:moduleID`      | `delivery_intent` and/or `release_notes`                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                   |
  | Uploads                                     | `multipart/form-data` with the file in `file`. Pack-scoped artifact uploads (`.../artifact/upload`, `.../modules/:moduleKey/artifact/upload`) also take `artifact_name` and `version`. `POST /artifacts` takes `name` and `version`. `POST /softwaremodules/by-id/:moduleID/artifacts` takes only the file |
</div>

<div className="lm-diff-ins lm-diff-block">
  Global artifacts [#global-artifacts]
</div>

<div className="lm-diff-ins lm-diff-block">
  | Method   | Path                      | Description                                                                                                                                                                                                                              |
  | -------- | ------------------------- | ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
  | `POST`   | `/artifacts`              | Upload a standalone artifact (fields `file`, `name`, `version`). hawkBit mode: only staged (discarded after 30 minutes, at the next upload) and cannot be attached to a module, so use `POST /softwaremodules/by-id/:moduleID/artifacts` |
  | `GET`    | `/artifacts`              | Fleet-wide catalog, with pack references                                                                                                                                                                                                 |
  | `GET`    | `/artifacts/:id`          | One artifact                                                                                                                                                                                                                             |
  | `GET`    | `/artifacts/:id/download` | Download the binary                                                                                                                                                                                                                      |
  | `DELETE` | `/artifacts/:id`          | Delete. Answers `204`                                                                                                                                                                                                                    |
</div>

<div className="lm-diff-ins lm-diff-block">
  Both `name` and `version` are optional on upload. `name` defaults to the file name without its extension. A `version`, when given, must be `x.y.z` and higher than every existing version of that name, or the upload answers `400`.
</div>

<div className="lm-diff-ins lm-diff-block">
  Launch campaigns [#launch-campaigns]
</div>

<div className="lm-diff-ins lm-diff-block">
  | Method         | Path                                       | Description                                                                   |
  | -------------- | ------------------------------------------ | ----------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
  | `POST`         | `/groups/:groupID/launch`                  | Create a launch. With `?dry_run=true`, evaluate only                          |
  | `GET`          | `/groups/:groupID/launch`                  | Launch history                                                                |
  | `POST`         | `/groups/:groupID/launch/:id/rollout`      | Dispatch the next batch                                                       |
  | `POST`         | `/groups/:groupID/launch/:id/pause`        | Pause. The batch in flight finishes                                           |
  | `POST`         | `/groups/:groupID/launch/:id/resume`       | Resume a paused launch                                                        |
  | `POST`         | `/groups/:groupID/launch/:id/retry-failed` | Re-queue the failed devices and roll out. `400` when nothing failed           |
  | `POST`         | `/groups/:groupID/launch/:id/cancel`       | Cancel permanently                                                            |
  | `POST`         | `/groups/:groupID/launch/:id/complete`     | Mark complete. hawkBit mode: `501`                                            |
  | `GET`          | `/groups/:groupID/launch/:id/strategy`     | Read the strategy                                                             |
  | `POST` / `PUT` | `/groups/:groupID/launch/:id/strategy`     | Update the strategy. hawkBit mode: `501`. The launched pack cannot be changed |
</div>

<div className="lm-diff-ins lm-diff-block">
  A launch in another group answers `404`, as if it did not exist.
</div>

<div className="lm-diff-ins lm-diff-block">
  Create body:
</div>

<div className="lm-diff-ins lm-diff-block">
  | Field                   | Required | Meaning                                                                                                                                                   |
  | ----------------------- | -------- | --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
  | `distribution_set_name` | Yes      | The pack to launch. It must be built                                                                                                                      |
  | `workflow_type`         | Yes      | `direct` or `phased`. The full WFX names (`wfx.workflow.dau.direct`) are accepted. hawkBit mode: `phased` makes a soft action, anything else a forced one |
  | `rollout_type`          | Yes      | `fixed` (a device count) or `percentage`                                                                                                                  |
  | `rollout_value`         | Yes      | Greater than 0                                                                                                                                            |
  | `test_device_id`        | No       | The canary: it goes alone first and must succeed before the rest                                                                                          |
  | `auto`                  | No       | Release the next batch automatically. Default `false`                                                                                                     |
  | `approval_threshold`    | No       | Percent of a batch that must succeed before the next one, 0 to 100. 0 means all of it                                                                     |
  | `error_threshold`       | No       | Percent of all devices allowed to fail before the launch is cancelled, 0 to 100. 0 means no limit                                                         |
  | `force_preconditions`   | No       | Deploy to every device even when preconditions fail. The failures are still recorded                                                                      |
  | `scheduled_at`          | No       | RFC 3339 start time. Native: the service starts the launch within about 30 seconds of it. hawkBit mode: hawkBit's scheduler starts it                     |
  | `name`, `description`   | No       | Display name (defaults to the pack name) and operator notes                                                                                               |
  | `weight`                | No       | A stored priority hint, 0 to 1000. Nothing enforces it                                                                                                    |
</div>

<div className="lm-diff-ins lm-diff-block">
  The strategy update body takes `workflow_type`, `rollout_type`, `rollout_value` (greater than 0), `test_device_id`, `auto`, `approval_threshold` and `error_threshold`. It replaces all of them: an omitted field resets to its zero value, so send the whole strategy.
</div>

<div className="lm-diff-ins lm-diff-block">
  A create answers `201` with `launch_id`, `precondition_failures`, `forced`, `superseded_devices` and `never_seen_devices`. A dry run answers `200` with `qualifying_devices`, `precondition_failures`, `superseded_devices` and `never_seen_devices`. The last two are filled only in hawkBit mode: devices with an update in flight, which creating the launch cancels, and devices that have never contacted hawkBit.
</div>

<div className="lm-diff-ins lm-diff-block">
  A launch is refused with `400` when the pack is not built, or when a per-device encrypted pack has devices without a package (dry runs included, and `force_preconditions` does not override it).
</div>

<div className="lm-diff-ins lm-diff-block">
  Jobs [#jobs]
</div>

<div className="lm-diff-ins lm-diff-block">
  | Method | Path                                        | Description                                                                                                                                                                          |
  | ------ | ------------------------------------------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ |
  | `GET`  | `/groups/:groupID/device/:deviceID/jobs`    | A device's jobs. `404` if the device is not in the group                                                                                                                             |
  | `GET`  | `/groups/:groupID/device/:deviceID/history` | A device's job history. `404` if there is none                                                                                                                                       |
  | `GET`  | `/launch/:launchID/jobs`                    | All jobs of a launch                                                                                                                                                                 |
  | `PUT`  | `/jobs/:jobID/transition`                   | Force a job into a state (body `state`, optional `message`, `progress`, `context`). Registered only when `enable_test_endpoints` is true. For tests only: it does no ownership check |
</div>

<div className="lm-diff-ins lm-diff-block">
  Device inventory [#device-inventory]
</div>

<div className="lm-diff-ins lm-diff-block">
  | Method | Path                                            | Description                                                                                                                                                                            |
  | ------ | ----------------------------------------------- | -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
  | `GET`  | `/devices/distribution-sets`                    | Pack versions across all devices, filterable                                                                                                                                           |
  | `GET`  | `/devices/:deviceID/distribution-sets`          | Pack versions on one device                                                                                                                                                            |
  | `GET`  | `/devices/:deviceID/distribution-set-inventory` | The device's packs, each with its artifacts                                                                                                                                            |
  | `GET`  | `/devices/:deviceID/distribution-set-updates`   | Update history of the device, newest first                                                                                                                                             |
  | `GET`  | `/devices/distribution-set-updates/latest`      | The newest update attempt for each device and pack, including attempts outside any launch. Filters apply to that attempt, so `status[eq]failed` lists devices whose last update failed |
</div>

<div className="lm-diff-ins lm-diff-block">
  Version compliance and latest versions [#version-compliance-and-latest-versions]
</div>

<div className="lm-diff-ins lm-diff-block">
  Declare the version devices should be on, then report and correct drift.
</div>

<div className="lm-diff-ins lm-diff-block">
  | Method   | Path                                                           | Description                                                                          |
  | -------- | -------------------------------------------------------------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ |
  | `GET`    | `/groups/:groupID/latest-distribution-sets`                    | A group's declared latest versions                                                   |
  | `PUT`    | `/groups/:groupID/latest-distribution-sets/:distributionSetID` | Declare a pack's latest version (body `{"version":"1.2.0"}`)                         |
  | `DELETE` | `/groups/:groupID/latest-distribution-sets/:distributionSetID` | Remove the declaration. Answers `204`                                                |
  | `GET`    | `/devices/:deviceID/latest-drift`                              | A device's drift from its group's latest versions. Optional `?groupID=`              |
  | `POST`   | `/devices/:deviceID/sync-to-latest`                            | Force the device to match. Answers `202` with the drift                              |
  | `POST`   | `/devices/:deviceID/force-version`                             | Launch one device to a version. Answers `202`                                        |
  | `GET`    | `/groups/:groupID/version-compliance`                          | Devices not on the latest version, as `{"group_id", "devices": [...]}`               |
  | `GET`    | `/groups/:groupID/version-status`                              | The full per-device matrix, compliant and outdated, as `{"group_id", "rows": [...]}` |
</div>

<div className="lm-diff-ins lm-diff-block">
  `sync-to-latest` takes an optional body with `groupID` (also accepted as `?groupID=`), `distribution_set_ids` to limit the packs and `workflow`. If some devices could not be dispatched it answers `207`, or `400` when none were, with `{"err": "...", "drift": {...}}`.
</div>

<div className="lm-diff-ins lm-diff-block">
  `force-version` takes `distribution_set_id` and `version` (required), `group_id` and `workflow`. The device must be a member of the pack's group. For a `swu` pack `workflow` defaults to `phased`, and for a `non-swu` pack to `download-install`. Native mode accepts only the pack's current version unless the pack has `allow_previous_version_download`, and `sync-to-latest` has the same limit. hawkBit mode ignores `workflow` in both routes.
</div>

<div className="lm-diff-ins lm-diff-block">
  A drift entry has `distribution_set_id`, `distribution_set_name`, `current_version`, `latest_version`, `in_sync` and `missing`. A `version-status` row has `device_id`, `distribution_set_id`, `distribution_set_name`, `current_version`, `latest_version`, `in_sync` and, when newer than the declared one, `newest_version`.
</div>

<div className="lm-diff-ins lm-diff-block">
  Device artifact download, hawkBit mode [#device-artifact-download-hawkbit-mode]
</div>

<div className="lm-diff-ins lm-diff-block">
  In hawkBit mode the service also serves hawkBit's device artifact URL, so a gateway can publish it on the same host as the rest of the API:
</div>

<div className="lm-diff-ins lm-diff-block">
  | Method        | Path                                                                                                 | Description                                                   |
  | ------------- | ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- | ------------------------------------------------------------- |
  | `GET`, `HEAD` | `<prefix>/:tenant/controller/v1/:controllerId/softwaremodules/:softwareModuleId/artifacts/:filename` | A module's artifact, or its `.MD5SUM` sidecar as `text/plain` |
</div>

<div className="lm-diff-ins lm-diff-block">
  `<prefix>` is the path of `hawkbit.ddi_url`, for example `/api/hawkbit-ddi`. The route is registered only in hawkBit mode. It answers only for modules in the device's assigned or installed set, and `404` otherwise, and `:tenant` must be the configured tenant. With presigning enabled it answers `302` like the other downloads.
</div>

<div className="lm-diff-ins lm-diff-block">
  SymKMS [#symkms]
</div>

<div className="lm-diff-ins lm-diff-block">
  Served at `/symkms/v1` by the same process when SymKMS is configured. It stores symmetric keys and binds them to devices. The encrypt, decrypt and MAC bodies and formats are in [Signing and encryption](/docs/platform/updates/signing-and-encryption). Errors use the same `{"err":"..."}` body.
</div>

<div className="lm-diff-ins lm-diff-block">
  | Method   | Path                                          | Description                                                                                                                                   |
  | -------- | --------------------------------------------- | --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
  | `POST`   | `/symkms/v1/`                                 | Store a key. Body `user_id`, `algorithm`, `key` (hex or Base64), optional `id`. Answers `201` with `id`, `user_id`, `algorithm`, `created_at` |
  | `GET`    | `/symkms/v1/?user_id=`                        | List a user's keys. `user_id` is required. Paginated, filterable by `user_id`, `algorithm`, `created_at`                                      |
  | `DELETE` | `/symkms/v1/:keyID?user_id=`                  | Delete a key. `user_id` is required and must own it                                                                                           |
  | `GET`    | `/symkms/v1/:keyID/raw?user_id=`              | Raw key material (`key_id`, `key_hex`, `algorithm`). Privileged                                                                               |
  | `POST`   | `/symkms/v1/encrypt`, `/decrypt`              | Encrypt or decrypt with a stored key                                                                                                          |
  | `POST`   | `/symkms/v1/mac`, `/mac/verify`               | Compute or verify a MAC (JSON body)                                                                                                           |
  | `POST`   | `/symkms/v1/mac/file`, `/mac/verify/file`     | The same, with the data as an uploaded `file`                                                                                                 |
  | `POST`   | `/symkms/v1/inventory/:deviceID/keys/:keyID`  | Assign a key to a device. Optional body `purpose`, `expires_at` (RFC 3339). Answers `201` with the binding                                    |
  | `DELETE` | `/symkms/v1/inventory/:deviceID/keys/:keyID`  | Revoke a key from a device                                                                                                                    |
  | `GET`    | `/symkms/v1/inventory/:deviceID`              | A device's key bindings. Paginated, filterable by `purpose`, `status`, `assigned_at`                                                          |
  | `GET`    | `/symkms/v1/inventory/by-key/:keyID`          | The devices a key is assigned to, as `key_id` and `device_ids`                                                                                |
  | `GET`    | `/symkms/v1/inventory/:deviceID/key?purpose=` | The device's raw key for a purpose, default `firmware-encryption`. Privileged. `404` without a binding                                        |
</div>

<div className="lm-diff-ins lm-diff-block">
  An empty `purpose` is a wildcard that matches any lookup, and a specific purpose is matched exactly. The routes that return raw key material trust the gateway to authenticate callers: do not expose them without mTLS or scoped tokens. See [Security](/docs/platform/updates/security).
</div>

<div className="lm-diff-ins lm-diff-block">
  Next steps [#next-steps]
</div>

<div className="lm-diff-ins lm-diff-block">
  * [Capabilities](/docs/platform/updates/reference/capabilities) for what each backend supports
  * [Update flow with curl, native backend](/docs/platform/updates/guides/native-curl)
  * [Update flow with curl, hawkBit backend](/docs/platform/updates/guides/hawkbit-curl)
</div>


# Capabilities (/docs/pr-preview/pr-56/platform/updates/reference/capabilities)



<div className="lm-diff-ins lm-diff-block">
  `GET /updates/v1/capabilities` tells a client which backend is active (`native` or `hawkbit`) and which of 22 features it supports. Read it once and hide what does not apply. An operation the backend does not implement answers **`501 Not Implemented`**, never `500`; a `501` is a permanent property of the deployment, so retrying will not help. The one exception is `GET /workflows`, which answers an empty list in hawkBit mode.
</div>

<div className="lm-diff-ins lm-diff-block">
  Read the capabilities [#read-the-capabilities]
</div>

<div className="lm-diff-ins lm-diff-block">
  The route takes no parameters and has no side effects. The service serves it without authentication, like `/health`; a gateway in front of it may still require a token.
</div>

<div className="lm-diff-ins lm-diff-block">
  ```bash
  curl -s https://lamassu.example.com/api/updates/v1/capabilities \
    -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN"
  ```
</div>

<div className="lm-diff-ins lm-diff-block">
  The response has three fields:
</div>

<div className="lm-diff-ins lm-diff-block">
  | Field         | Type             | Meaning                                                                                                                   |
  | ------------- | ---------------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
  | `backend`     | string           | `native` or `hawkbit`                                                                                                     |
  | `supported`   | object           | One boolean per flag. It always carries all 22 keys, so a missing key means a client/server version skew, not "supported" |
  | `unsupported` | array of strings | The flags that are `false`, repeated for convenience, in the order of the table below                                     |
</div>

<div className="lm-diff-ins lm-diff-block">
  An example for a native deployment:
</div>

<div className="lm-diff-ins lm-diff-block">
  ```json
  {
    "backend": "native",
    "supported": {
      "latest_versions": true,
      "version_compliance": true,
      "artifact_signatures": true,
      "artifact_encryption": true,
      "per_device_encryption": true,
      "artifact_download_by_name": true,
      "workflows": true,
      "launch_strategy_update": true,
      "launch_complete": true,
      "launch_device_assignment": true,
      "scheduled_launch": true,
      "push_events": true,
      "launch_preconditions": true,
      "campaigns": true,
      "canary_device": true,
      "device_inventory": true,
      "artifact_catalog": true,
      "prebuilt_deliverable": true,
      "software_module_composition": true,
      "software_module_deliverables": false,
      "standalone_software_modules": true,
      "software_module_replace": false
    },
    "unsupported": ["software_module_deliverables", "software_module_replace"]
  }
  ```
</div>

<div className="lm-diff-ins lm-diff-block">
  Per-backend support [#per-backend-support]
</div>

<div className="lm-diff-ins lm-diff-block">
  "Yes" means supported. "Conditional" means it depends on configuration or on the hawkBit server; see the notes after the table.
</div>

<div className="lm-diff-ins lm-diff-block">
  | Capability                                                                                                  | native                  | hawkbit                       |
  | ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- | ----------------------- | ----------------------------- |
  | `latest_versions`: declare the latest version per group, plus per-device drift and force-sync               | Yes                     | Yes                           |
  | `version_compliance`: group-wide compliance and version-status reports                                      | Yes                     | Yes                           |
  | `artifact_signatures`: signed version manifests and the artifacts archive                                   | Yes                     | Yes                           |
  | `artifact_encryption`: shared-key encryption and KMS signing at build                                       | Yes                     | Conditional                   |
  | `per_device_encryption`: one deliverable per device, each with its own key                                  | Yes                     | **No**                        |
  | `artifact_download_by_name`: fetch a pack's staged file by file name                                        | Yes                     | Yes                           |
  | `workflows`: choose the WFX workflow per launch                                                             | Yes                     | **No**                        |
  | `launch_strategy_update`: edit the strategy after creation                                                  | Yes                     | **No**                        |
  | `launch_complete`: mark a launch complete early                                                             | Yes                     | **No**                        |
  | `launch_device_assignment`: add devices to a launch after creation (a service operation with no HTTP route) | Yes                     | **No**                        |
  | `scheduled_launch`: start a launch at a future time                                                         | Yes (the service polls) | Yes (hawkBit's own scheduler) |
  | `push_events`: server-pushed job state                                                                      | Yes                     | **No** (poll)                 |
  | `launch_preconditions`: gate the deployable devices on installed versions                                   | Yes                     | Yes                           |
  | `campaigns`: plan, start, pause, resume, cancel, retry failed                                               | Yes                     | Yes                           |
  | `canary_device`: the first batch is one named device                                                        | Yes                     | Yes                           |
  | `device_inventory`: which pack version a device carries, and its update history                             | Yes                     | Yes                           |
  | `artifact_catalog`: fleet-wide artifact catalog and per-pack listing                                        | Yes                     | Yes                           |
  | `prebuilt_deliverable`: attach an externally built file to a pack                                           | Yes                     | **No**                        |
  | `software_module_composition`: a pack is a composition of typed modules                                     | Yes                     | Conditional                   |
  | `software_module_deliverables`: each module has its own deliverable                                         | **No**                  | Yes                           |
  | `standalone_software_modules`: create a module with no pack                                                 | Yes                     | Conditional                   |
  | `software_module_replace`: swap a module for another version of itself                                      | **No**                  | Conditional                   |
</div>

<div className="lm-diff-ins lm-diff-block">
  Conditional flags in hawkBit mode [#conditional-flags-in-hawkbit-mode]
</div>

<div className="lm-diff-ins lm-diff-block">
  * **`artifact_encryption`** is reported unsupported only when none of `swugenerator_path`, `symkms_endpoint` and `kms_endpoint` is configured. Each build option still needs its own settings: see [Signing and encryption](/docs/platform/updates/signing-and-encryption).
  * **`software_module_composition`, `standalone_software_modules` and `software_module_replace`** depend on the hawkBit server having the pre-seeded `os` and `application` module types and the `os_app` or `app` set type. The service probes this with a 5 second timeout, caches the result for about five minutes and assumes support when hawkBit is unreachable. When the probe fails, all three flags are reported unsupported together.
  * **`software_module_deliverables`** is always reported supported in hawkBit mode. Building a `swu-build` module still needs a `swugenerator_path`, and without one the build answers `501`.
  * **`prebuilt_deliverable`**: a hawkBit pack is never built directly. A `swu-prebuilt` catalog module accepts a finished `.swu` instead.
</div>

<div className="lm-diff-ins lm-diff-block">
  Flags that differ in meaning [#flags-that-differ-in-meaning]
</div>

<div className="lm-diff-ins lm-diff-block">
  Both backends report `software_module_composition`, but importing a module **links** it in hawkBit mode (both packs share one module) and **copies** it in native mode. The reusable-modules list reports this per candidate in its `shared` field, so a client can tell the operator which one they get. See [Concepts](/docs/platform/updates/concepts).
</div>

<div className="lm-diff-ins lm-diff-block">
  In native mode a launch dispatches one job per device with a single download URI, so a module has no deliverable of its own: the pack builds one `.swu` from every module's inputs. That is why `software_module_deliverables` and `software_module_replace` are unsupported there.
</div>

<div className="lm-diff-ins lm-diff-block">
  What a client should do [#what-a-client-should-do]
</div>

<div className="lm-diff-ins lm-diff-block">
  * Call `capabilities` once at start-up and before showing a feature the table marks as backend-dependent.
  * Treat a `501` on a route as authoritative: hide the action instead of retrying.
  * Do not infer the backend from the URL. Both serve the same `/updates/v1` routes; see the [API reference](/docs/platform/updates/reference/api) for which routes answer `501` in which backend.
  * Re-read the capabilities after changing hawkBit's module types or the build configuration.
</div>

<div className="lm-diff-ins lm-diff-block">
  Next steps [#next-steps]
</div>

<div className="lm-diff-ins lm-diff-block">
  * [API reference](/docs/platform/updates/reference/api)
  * [hawkBit mode](/docs/platform/updates/hawkbit-mode)
</div>


# Configuration reference (/docs/pr-preview/pr-56/platform/updates/reference/configuration)



<div className="lm-diff-ins lm-diff-block">
  Lamassu Updates reads a single YAML file at start-up. This page lists every key the code reads, its default, and which backend (`native` or `hawkbit`) uses it. Keys that appear in the example files but are not read are listed separately so you do not rely on them.
</div>

<div className="lm-diff-ins lm-diff-block">
  How the configuration is loaded [#how-the-configuration-is-loaded]
</div>

<div className="lm-diff-ins lm-diff-block">
  * Set the file location with the `OTA_CONFIG_FILE` environment variable. If it is unset, the service reads `/etc/lamassuiot/config.yml`, which is where the Docker image and the Helm chart mount it.
  * If `OTA_CONFIG_FILE` names a file that cannot be loaded (missing, or invalid YAML), the service logs a warning and **falls back to `/etc/lamassuiot/config.yml`**. In the Docker image that path holds the repository's developer `config.yml`, so a typo in the path can start the service with the wrong settings. If the fallback fails too, the service exits.
  * The file is read once. Restart the service after any change.
  * `LAMASSU_CONFIG_FILE`, which the Dockerfile and the Helm chart set, is not read by the code. Only `OTA_CONFIG_FILE` matters.
  * Any key can be overridden by an environment variable. See [Environment variables](#environment-variables).
</div>

<div className="lm-diff-ins lm-diff-block">
  The [repository](https://github.com/lamassuiot/ota) ships three examples:
</div>

<div className="lm-diff-ins lm-diff-block">
  | File                 | For                                                                                          |
  | -------------------- | -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
  | `config.yml`         | Local development in `native` mode                                                           |
  | `config-docker.yml`  | The `updates` container of `docker-compose.yml`                                              |
  | `config-hawkbit.yml` | Local development in `hawkbit` mode against the hawkBit of the compose file (host port 8090) |
</div>

<div className="lm-diff-ins lm-diff-block">
  The examples contain values for one developer machine (absolute paths and LAN addresses) and development secrets. Replace all of them, and never reuse their keys or passwords.
</div>

<div className="lm-diff-ins lm-diff-block">
  Which keys each mode reads [#which-keys-each-mode-reads]
</div>

<div className="lm-diff-ins lm-diff-block">
  | Key                                                     | `native`       | `hawkbit`                  |
  | ------------------------------------------------------- | -------------- | -------------------------- |
  | `mode`, `app.*`, `storage.*`                            | Yes            | Yes                        |
  | `dms_endpoint`                                          | Yes (required) | Optional                   |
  | `kms_endpoint`, `sign_script_path`, `swugenerator_path` | Yes            | Yes, only to build or sign |
  | `symkms_endpoint`, `symkms`, `sym_keys_dir`             | Yes            | Yes, only for encryption   |
  | `max_artifact_size_mb`, `enable_test_endpoints`         | Yes            | Yes                        |
  | `wfx_endpoint`, `workflow_file`, `update_domain`        | Yes            | No                         |
  | `update_files_base_dir`, `artifacts`, `builds`          | Yes            | No                         |
  | `leader_election`                                       | Yes            | No                         |
  | `hawkbit`                                               | No             | Yes (required)             |
  | `build_memory_limit_mb`                                 | No             | Yes                        |
</div>

<div className="lm-diff-ins lm-diff-block">
  `mode` is `native` when empty or when it holds any value other than `hawkbit`.
</div>

<div className="lm-diff-ins lm-diff-block">
  General and server settings [#general-and-server-settings]
</div>

<div className="lm-diff-ins lm-diff-block">
  | Key                           | Type     | Default                | Description                                                                                                                                                                                                                      |
  | ----------------------------- | -------- | ---------------------- | -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
  | `mode`                        | string   | empty (`native`)       | `native` or `hawkbit`. See [hawkBit mode](/docs/platform/updates/hawkbit-mode).                                                                                                                                                  |
  | `app.logs.level`              | string   | `info`                 | `trace`, `debug`, `info`, `warn`, `error`, `fatal` or `none` (case-insensitive). An unrecognised value becomes `info`. At `info` the start-up log prints a harmless "unknown log level" warning. `none` discards all log output. |
  | `app.server.listen_address`   | string   | empty (all interfaces) | Address to bind. The examples use `0.0.0.0`.                                                                                                                                                                                     |
  | `app.server.port`             | integer  | none (required)        | HTTP port. `0` picks a random port. The examples and the chart use `10090`.                                                                                                                                                      |
  | `app.server.shutdown_timeout` | duration | `60s`                  | How long to wait for in-flight requests after `SIGTERM` or `SIGINT`. Keep it below the termination grace period of the pod (the chart sets 120 s).                                                                               |
  | `enable_test_endpoints`       | boolean  | `false`                | Registers `PUT /updates/v1/jobs/:jobID/transition`, which forges a job state change without ownership checks. Use only in tests; keep it `false` anywhere else.                                                                  |
</div>

<div className="lm-diff-ins lm-diff-block">
  The service always serves plain HTTP. These keys exist in the configuration structs and in the example files but **are not read**, so setting them has no effect: `app.server.protocol`, `app.server.log_level`, `app.server.health_check` (and the `health_check_logging` of the examples), `app.server.cert_file`, `app.server.key_file` and `app.server.authentication.mutual_tls.*`. Terminate TLS in front of the service. See [Security](/docs/platform/updates/security).
</div>

<div className="lm-diff-ins lm-diff-block">
  Database [#database]
</div>

<div className="lm-diff-ins lm-diff-block">
  ```yaml
  storage:
    provider: "postgres"
    hostname: "postgres"
    port: 5432
    username: "postgres"
    password: "<password>"
    log_level: info
  ```
</div>

<div className="lm-diff-ins lm-diff-block">
  | Key                                    | Type    | Default         | Description                                                            |
  | -------------------------------------- | ------- | --------------- | ---------------------------------------------------------------------- |
  | `storage.provider`                     | string  | none            | Only `postgres` exists. The value is not checked.                      |
  | `storage.hostname`                     | string  | none (required) | Postgres host. In `hawkbit` mode startup fails if it is empty.         |
  | `storage.port`                         | integer | none (required) | Postgres port. There is no default.                                    |
  | `storage.username`, `storage.password` | string  | none            | Credentials.                                                           |
  | `storage.log_level`                    | string  | `info`          | Log level of the database layer. SQL statements are logged at `trace`. |
</div>

<div className="lm-diff-ins lm-diff-block">
  * The database name is fixed to **`updates`**. There is no key for it. The service creates its tables and migrates them at start-up, but it does not create the database: create `updates` first. In Docker Compose, `init.sql` creates `updates` and `hawkbit`, and `POSTGRES_DB` creates `wfx`.
  * The connection uses `sslmode=disable`. There is no way to enable TLS towards Postgres from the configuration. Keep the database on a private network.
  * Each process keeps at most 25 open and 10 idle connections (connections are recycled after 30 minutes, or 5 idle minutes). Budget `25 x replicas` against the `max_connections` of Postgres.
</div>

<div className="lm-diff-ins lm-diff-block">
  Endpoints of other services [#endpoints-of-other-services]
</div>

<div className="lm-diff-ins lm-diff-block">
  | Key               | Default | Mode                                        | Description                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                   |
  | ----------------- | ------- | ------------------------------------------- | --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
  | `dms_endpoint`    | none    | Required in `native`, optional in `hawkbit` | Base URL of the Lamassu Device Manager API, for example `http://host:8080/api/devmanager`. It is the source of device groups. Without it in `hawkbit` mode, groups are read from the `group:<id>` tags of the hawkBit targets. The service sends `X-Principal-ID: admin-mode` on these calls. |
  | `kms_endpoint`    | none    | Both                                        | Base URL of the Lamassu KMS API, for example `http://host:8080/api/kms/v1`. Needed to sign. See [Signing and encryption](/docs/platform/updates/signing-and-encryption).                                                                                                                      |
  | `symkms_endpoint` | none    | Both                                        | Base URL of SymKMS, **without** the `/symkms/v1` path. In the monolith it points at the service itself (for example `http://localhost:10090`) and must match `app.server.port`. Empty means encryption is refused.                                                                            |
  | `wfx_endpoint`    | none    | `native`                                    | Base URL of the WFX **management** API (port `8081` inside the Compose network, `9081` on the host). The service appends `/api/wfx/v1/`. Startup fails if WFX cannot be reached. Devices use the WFX client port instead.                                                                     |
  | `update_domain`   | none    | `native`                                    | Public base URL devices use to download builds, for example `http://updates:10090/updates/v1/`. It **must end in `/updates/v1/`, with the trailing slash**: the service appends `groups/...` directly and stores the result as the pack URI. It must be reachable from the devices.           |
</div>

<div className="lm-diff-ins lm-diff-block">
  Build and signing [#build-and-signing]
</div>

<div className="lm-diff-ins lm-diff-block">
  | Key                     | Default                                                           | Mode      | Description                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                         |
  | ----------------------- | ----------------------------------------------------------------- | --------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
  | `swugenerator_path`     | `swugenerator` on the `PATH` in `native`; unset in `hawkbit`      | Both      | Path to the `swugenerator` binary. In `hawkbit` mode the SWU builder exists only when this is set: without it, `swu-build` modules cannot be built (`501`). Raw-module builds do not need it.                                                                       |
  | `sign_script_path`      | none                                                              | Both      | The signer script swugenerator calls for `.swu` signing, `sign_kms.sh` (`/app/sign_kms.sh` in the image). Signing a `.swu` needs this and `kms_endpoint`; the service refuses a signing request when either is missing.                                             |
  | `workflow_file`         | `wfx.workflow.dau.direct.yml` (relative to the working directory) | `native`  | Path of the `direct` WFX workflow. The name **must contain `direct`**: the `phased`, `download-install` and `simple` files are found by replacing that word in the path, and startup fails otherwise. The service uploads the workflows missing in WFX at start-up. |
  | `update_files_base_dir` | none                                                              | `native`  | Base directory for build scratch (`in/`) and, until builds are published to the `builds` store, build outputs (`out/`). It also supplies the default `local_dir` of `artifacts` and `builds`.                                                                       |
  | `sym_keys_dir`          | none                                                              | Both      | Fallback directory for SymKMS key storage when `symkms.storage.local_dir` is empty.                                                                                                                                                                                 |
  | `build_memory_limit_mb` | `0` (no check)                                                    | `hawkbit` | Refuses a build that would encrypt a file in memory (about twice its size) above this limit, in MiB, before the process is killed for lack of memory.                                                                                                               |
</div>

<div className="lm-diff-ins lm-diff-block">
  Upload limits [#upload-limits]
</div>

<div className="lm-diff-ins lm-diff-block">
  | Key                    | Type    | Default          | Description                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                 |
  | ---------------------- | ------- | ---------------- | --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
  | `max_artifact_size_mb` | integer | `10240` (10 GiB) | Largest single uploaded file in MiB: artifact or prebuilt `.swu`. A larger multipart file gets `413` with the message `file "<name>" is <n> MiB; the maximum upload size is <m> MiB`. The HTTP body limit is this value plus 1 MiB. Values of `0` or less mean the default. |
</div>

<div className="lm-diff-ins lm-diff-block">
  Uploads are streamed: memory does not grow with the file, but each in-flight upload is written to a temporary file under `TMPDIR` (default `/tmp`) first, so it needs that much free disk. Any proxy in front of the service must accept the same size and keep the connection open: read and write timeouts are 6 hours and idle connections are closed after 5 minutes. See [Operations](/docs/platform/updates/operations#upload-size-and-proxies).
</div>

<div className="lm-diff-ins lm-diff-block">
  Blob storage blocks [#blob-storage-blocks]
</div>

<div className="lm-diff-ins lm-diff-block">
  Four blocks share one layout, so artifacts, build outputs and key material can each live on local disk or in S3:
</div>

<div className="lm-diff-ins lm-diff-block">
  | Block                    | Mode      | Holds                                                                                           | Default                                                                              |
  | ------------------------ | --------- | ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ |
  | `artifacts`              | `native`  | Uploaded artifact binaries                                                                      | Local, `{update_files_base_dir}/artifacts`                                           |
  | `builds`                 | `native`  | Build outputs devices download: `.swu` and `.tar.gz`                                            | Local, `{update_files_base_dir}/out`                                                 |
  | `symkms`                 | Both      | Symmetric keys and device-key assignments                                                       | Local, `sym_keys_dir`, or `data` relative to the working directory if both are empty |
  | `hawkbit.artifact_store` | `hawkbit` | Read only, to sign download URLs of hawkBit's S3 bucket (see [`hawkbit` block](#hawkbit-block)) | None                                                                                 |
</div>

<div className="lm-diff-ins lm-diff-block">
  ```yaml
  artifacts:
    storage:
      type: s3                       # local (default) or s3
      s3_bucket: "ota-updates"
      s3_prefix: "ota/artifacts/"
      s3_endpoint: "http://rustfs:9000"
      s3_path_style: true
      s3_access_key_id_file: /etc/ota/s3/access-key
      s3_secret_access_key_file: /etc/ota/s3/secret-key
    encryption:
      type: none                     # none (default), local or awskms
  ```
</div>

<div className="lm-diff-ins lm-diff-block">
  Storage (*.storage) [#storage-storage]
</div>

<div className="lm-diff-ins lm-diff-block">
  | Key                                                  | Default             | Description                                                                                                                                                                                            |
  | ---------------------------------------------------- | ------------------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ |
  | `type`                                               | `local`             | `local` or `s3`.                                                                                                                                                                                       |
  | `local_dir`                                          | block default above | Directory for `local`. Created with mode `0700`.                                                                                                                                                       |
  | `s3_bucket`                                          | none                | Required for `s3`. The bucket must exist: the service checks access at start-up and stops if it fails (`S3 bucket "x" is not accessible at ...`).                                                      |
  | `s3_region`                                          | `us-east-1`         | AWS region.                                                                                                                                                                                            |
  | `s3_endpoint`                                        | empty (AWS)         | URL of an S3-compatible store such as RustFS or MinIO.                                                                                                                                                 |
  | `s3_path_style`                                      | `false`             | Address buckets as `<endpoint>/<bucket>`. Most self-hosted stores need `true`.                                                                                                                         |
  | `s3_prefix`                                          | empty               | Keeps every key under a "folder" of the bucket. One bucket can hold several stores, hawkBit's artifacts included. A missing trailing `/` is added.                                                     |
  | `s3_access_key_id`, `s3_secret_access_key`           | none                | Static credentials. Set both or neither.                                                                                                                                                               |
  | `s3_access_key_id_file`, `s3_secret_access_key_file` | none                | The same credentials read from files, for example a mounted Kubernetes Secret. Re-read every minute, so a rotated Secret needs no restart. Set both or neither, and not together with the inline pair. |
</div>

<div className="lm-diff-ins lm-diff-block">
  With no credential set, the AWS default chain applies (environment, IRSA, instance profile).
</div>

<div className="lm-diff-ins lm-diff-block">
  At-rest encryption (*.encryption) [#at-rest-encryption-encryption]
</div>

<div className="lm-diff-ins lm-diff-block">
  | Key             | Default     | Description                                      |
  | --------------- | ----------- | ------------------------------------------------ |
  | `type`          | `none`      | `none`, `local` or `awskms`.                     |
  | `local_key`     | none        | Required for `local`: a hex-encoded 32-byte key. |
  | `awskms_key_id` | none        | Required for `awskms`: key ARN or alias.         |
  | `awskms_region` | `us-east-1` | Region of the AWS KMS key.                       |
</div>

<div className="lm-diff-ins lm-diff-block">
  An encrypted object is encrypted and decrypted whole, in memory: with at-rest encryption, reading or writing a 10 GiB artifact needs that much memory, and byte ranges are cut from the decrypted copy. A store with encryption enabled cannot use presigned downloads. For large files, prefer encrypting at the store (for example S3 server-side encryption) instead.
</div>

<div className="lm-diff-ins lm-diff-block">
  Presigned downloads (*.presign) [#presigned-downloads-presign]
</div>

<div className="lm-diff-ins lm-diff-block">
  With S3 storage, a download can be answered with `302` to a short-lived signed URL of the store instead of streaming the bytes through the service. The caller is authorized first, as for any download. Native mode signs build outputs (`builds.presign`); `hawkbit` mode signs the objects of hawkBit's S3 plugin (`hawkbit.artifact_store.presign`). Artifact downloads by ID in `native` mode are always streamed.
</div>

<div className="lm-diff-ins lm-diff-block">
  ```yaml
  builds:
    storage: {type: s3, s3_bucket: ota-updates, s3_prefix: ota/builds/,
              s3_endpoint: http://rustfs:9000, s3_path_style: true,
              s3_access_key_id_file: /etc/ota/s3/access-key,
              s3_secret_access_key_file: /etc/ota/s3/secret-key}
    presign:
      enabled: true
      public_endpoint: https://updates.example.com
      ttl: 60s
      access_key_id_file: /etc/ota/presign/access-key
      secret_access_key_file: /etc/ota/presign/secret-key
  ```
</div>

<div className="lm-diff-ins lm-diff-block">
